documents.C:
# C

## Purpose

The C module contains the CService implementation in c/service.c. It is the source-level native service surface for this fixture and gives callers a concrete type to work with. This page explains the analyzed component instead of treating the directory name as an architectural boundary.

## Architecture

The CService implementation in c/service.c is a leaf with no recorded dependency edges. Its lifecycle is local: a caller reaches the service type, uses its fields or methods, and remains within this source file.

## Responsibilities

CService owns the native service representation. The [Native module](Native.md) supplies the parent architectural context.

documents.Native:
# Native

## Purpose

Native is the selected native execution subsystem. It gives the Rust implementation a shared context while retaining the C service as a representative source anchor rather than creating a page for every analyzed language component.

## Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  C --> Native
  Rust --> Native
```

The [Rust](Rust.md) page describes the concrete implementation selected for source-level reading; the parent retains the C anchor as evidence for the broader native boundary.

## Responsibilities

Native explains the native subsystem boundary and the relationship between its representative source anchors and the documented implementation page.
documents.JVM:
# JVM

## Purpose

JVM groups the Java, Kotlin, and Scala service implementations into a subsystem organized around the JVM language family. Its page explains the shared architecture while the children retain language-specific source details.

## Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Java --> JVM
  Kotlin --> JVM
  Scala --> JVM
```

Read the [Java](Java.md), [Kotlin](Kotlin.md), and [Scala](Scala.md) pages for the concrete components and source paths.

## Responsibilities

JVM provides subsystem context and navigation for the three implementations without replacing their leaf documentation.

documents.Platform:
# Platform

## Purpose

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Native --> Platform
  Scripting --> Platform
```

The [Native](Native.md) and [Scripting](Scripting.md) pages explain the two architectural branches and link onward to their representative implementation pages.

## Responsibilities

overview:
# Replay Wiki

## Purpose

This fixture repository demonstrates a cross-language service platform. The wiki organizes the analyzed implementations by architectural family so a reader can move from the end-to-end repository shape to a language-specific source page without mistaking directories for behavior.

## Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Client[Service client] --> Platform
  Platform --> Native
  Native --> Rust
  Platform --> JVM
  JVM --> Java
  Platform --> Scripting
  Scripting --> Python
```

The [Platform](Platform.md) page is the starting point for the top-level architecture. It connects the family overviews to representative language implementations, which in turn link to the source-grounded leaf pages.

## Responsibilities

This repository overview explains the request path through the platform, the subsystem relationships, and the boundary between architecture pages and implementation pages.
